quest.title: Pirate Invasion, in Liyue Harbor!
quest.description: There's a group of kids who are very eager to play a pirate-themed game...

talks.objective: Talk to Little Lulu, Little Fei, and Little Meng

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Meng, today I get to be the captain — right?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Lulu, I've been the captain loads of times in a row now, we should let Fei have a turn.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: But Meng, you're the bestest captain ever! I want you to keep being it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: We're trying to play a game. They promised me I could be the captain this time...

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: But Lulu keeps saying it's way more fun when Meng is the captain.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: *sigh* Lulu always does this... But, if it's what she wants... I guess it's fine by me.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Hey, do you have time to join in? You can be the pirate!

response.speaker: Little Fei
response.text: *sigh* Once again, as always, I'm just the first mate...

response.speaker: Little Fei
response.text: Just like last time, come and join us when you're ready.

choices.text: But I wanna be one of the good guys.

response.speaker: Little Fei
response.text: *sigh* Ah, I really wanna be the captain...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ready.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Alright then. I guess we can start.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: I hate being the first mate...

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Lulu and Meng only care about themselves...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ar! Do I spy me some pieces of eight? Hand 'em over!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Oh, hi pirate. Sorry, I'm just a poor first mate with nothing for you to steal.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: If you're here to rob the boat, you need to find someone with enough money... Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: I know! The captain is really rich — you should go and steal from him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What!? Don't you work on this boat?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Yeah! That means I know how to find the captain.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: He's just a captain anyway... What's so special about that...

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Come with me! I'll take you to the captain...

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Here we are! Here's the captain!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: What are you doing, bringing the pirates here!? You should've led them on a wild goose chase so that me and Lulu would have time to escape!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Why do you and Lulu get to escape while I have to stay here and hold the pirates up!?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: I got a better idea: I give you over to the pirates while I escape with Lulu!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: But... Beidou says you should never abandon your friends!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Oh? And does Beidou also say that the captain should run away with their favorite person at the first sign of trouble!?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Why you little... I'm never sharing my Lotus Heads with you EVER again!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: FINE! It's only you who cares so much about stupid Lotus Heads anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They are blowing this way out of proportion...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I know a way we can sort this out.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Lotus Heads are their favorite thing in the world... Giving them their favorite treat will definitely calm them down.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Can you find some Lotus Heads for me?

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: Thank you! You need to be quick though.

choices.text: It's not Lotus Heads they're fighting over...

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: Oh... Really? Well what is it?

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: ...Anyway, just get some Lotus Heads. We can't have them arguing like this all day.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Did you find some Lotus Heads yet?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Yup.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: You're the meanie!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: No, you're the meanie!

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Stop fighting. You're only going to wear yourselves out.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: It's just a game, there's no need to get so mad. We're all friends, right?

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: And look what I've got... Freshly picked Lotus Heads! Go on, help yourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Once you've eaten, we're gonna straighten all this out.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: We'll decide who gets to be the captain and the first mate, and in what order. Sound good?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Fine...

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Okay...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, it actually worked! Peace and quiet at last.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Told you so!

choices.text: How did you know that would work?

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: We've been playing together a long time. I know these things.

choices.text: Little Lulu is a miracle worker...

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: Heeh-hee, thanks. But Beidou is the real miracle worker.

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: I hope I can be like her when I grow up...

talks.objective: Calm Little Meng and Little Fei down

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Ready yet?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: You traitor! This is mutiny!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: What, you can't cope with things not going your way for a change?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I'm never sharing my Lotus Heads with you EVER again!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: FINE! It's only you who cares so much about stupid Lotus Heads anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Haha... This looks like it could take a while...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Did you find some Lotus Heads yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: You'd better hurry up, the longer they're like this the worse it'll get.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Never mind, take your time. Boring game anyway...
